sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Communication Services / Telecom Services · Indonesia. PT Indosat Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, provides telecommunications and digital technology services in Indonesia. It operates through three segments: Cellular; Multimedia, Internet & Data Communication; and Fixed Telecommunications. The company provides various mobile, wireless broadband, and fixed and digital telecommunications services.
